name: Lemon Italian Ice

ingredients.name: lemon juice, from about 8 whole lemons
lemon zest, from about 8 whole lemons

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl or measuring cup, dissolve sugar in boiling water. Whisk in lemon juice, lemon zest, and lemon extract. Refrigerate and chill completely, 2 to 3 hours.

Add mixture to ice cream maker and prepare according to manufacturer's directions until icy crystals form and you have a thick, slush-like mixture. Transfer to a large bowl or container and return to freezer to freeze to desired degree of firmness, about 2 to 3 hours.

schema_metadata.keywords: american classics, citrus desserts, granita, ice cream, italian desserts, italian ice, sorbet

description: Making bright and tart Lemon Italian Ice at home is super easy. All you need is some sugar, water, a whole bunch of lemon and some lemon extract.
notes: Total time, including resting: 4 hr 35 min.
author: Alexandra Penfold
